entities.summary: Rechon Malik "Leaky" Black is an American professional basketball player for the Washington Wizards of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Capital City Go-Go of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the North Carolina Tar Heels.
